zh.title: 这部鹈鹕短片是怎么做的

sections.p:
整部片子只从一段话开始：

“每次有新模型发布，大家都让它画‘一只骑自行车的鹈鹕’来判断空间能力，而且几乎都是用 HTML 和 SVG 做动画。我真的看腻了，所以我想让你做出最复杂、最精细、最漂亮的‘鹈鹕骑自行车’动画视频。什么技术都可以用。不着急，你可以花一整天来画。”

Claude Opus 5.5（在 Claude Code 里）写了全部代码，没有手工建模。
Blender 5.2：三维场景和渲染（Cycles 渲染器）。
Rust：专门写了一个体积云渲染器，算出 12K 的日落天空。
Python：程序化生成约 2.4 万根羽毛、能转的自行车（36 根编织辐条、92 节链条）和所有动作；配乐和音效也用 Python 合成。
ffmpeg：合成最终视频。
用 Blender Cycles 做路径追踪，真实模拟光线的反射和折射。1920×1080，每帧 40 采样加降噪，带运动模糊和景深。正式渲染前先出了低清样片检查动作。
一台笔记本的 GTX 1650 Ti 显卡（4 GB），792 帧，平均每帧约 42 秒，总共约 9 小时 19 分钟。之后补渲 65 帧修正细节，又用了约 50 分钟。
成片 33 秒，画面和声音全部由代码生成，没有用任何现成模型、贴图或音乐。

en.title: How this pelican film was made

sections.p:
The whole film started from one paragraph:

“Every time a new model comes out, everyone has it draw "a pelican riding a bicycle" to judge its spatial ability, and it's almost always animated with HTML and SVG. I'm honestly tired of looking at them, so I want you to make the most complex, most detailed, most beautiful animated video of "a pelican riding a bicycle". You can use any technology. There's no rush; you can spend a whole day drawing it.”

Claude Opus 5.5 (in Claude Code) wrote all of the code; nothing was modelled by hand.
Blender 5.2: the 3D scene and the rendering (Cycles).
Rust: a purpose-built volumetric cloud renderer for the 12K sunset sky.
Python: about 24,000 procedurally placed feathers, a working bicycle (36 laced spokes, 92 chain links) and all of the animation; the score and sound effects were synthesized in Python too.
ffmpeg: assembling the final video.

Path-traced in Blender Cycles, simulating real reflection and refraction of light. 1920×1080, 40 samples per frame plus denoising, with motion blur and depth of field. A low-resolution animatic checked the motion before the final render.
A laptop GTX 1650 Ti (4 GB) rendered 792 frames at about 42 seconds each, roughly 9 hours 19 minutes in total. Re-rendering 65 frames to fix details took about 50 more minutes.
A 33-second film whose every frame and sound was generated in code, with no stock models, textures or music.
